scientific_integrity: The p=1 exact law and p=2 asymptotic are prior results of Gunawan, Peca-Medlin and Zhong. New claims are the fixed interior/super-Hilbert regimes and p=2 logarithmic crossover; the explicit proof uses angular Gaussian Laplace asymptotics and extreme-value transfer. Deterministic quadrature checks do not substitute for proof; independent external audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the first pivot of standard-normalized GUE using fixed real/imaginary l^p entry comparisons; no full permutation law, stability claim, or uniform fixed-p estimates across p=2. The critical window has fixed real parameter.
title: First GUE pivot: a sharp norm-exponent phase diagram and Hilbert-window crossover
